CVH-003.title: State-Preserving Context Compactor & UI Token Gauge
CVH-003.author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
CVH-003.commitMessage: refactor(drawer): unify IPC callpath to compact_context in drawerStore
CVH-003.summary: Implemented State-Preserving Context Compactor and UI Token Gauge for CanbanVoimaxHarness. Rust backend features 4 Immutable Anchors (System prompt, Task prompt, Execution state Markdown snapshot, and last 2 working turns), Zero-Cost Log Evaporation (replacing tool logs >500 chars older than 3 turns with deterministic metadata placeholders without LLM calls), and Structured State Snapshots. Added `compact_context` IPC command returning CompactionReport and emitting `agent:compacted` event. Frontend features tactile ContextGauge with Emerald/Amber/Crimson thresholds, Web Audio API mechanical click synthesis, flame toast notification, ripple animation, and client/backend compaction trigger. Level 2 review caveat regarding IPC callpath desynchronization in drawerStore was fully resolved in af2e1ca with unified primary call to compact_context and backward-compatible fallback. Verified with 0 errors via cargo check and npm run build.

CVH-005.summary: Full end-to-end integration of Card-as-a-Chat, Tool Policy Matrix (Allow/Ask/Deny zero-trust per-stage policy modal), Deterministic Prefix Caching (alphabetical tool ordering + Anthropic ephemeral cache breakpoints), Tool Output Spilling (>12KB stdout/stderr logs spilled to .cvh/spill/), State-Preserving Context Compactor (evaporates old tool outputs, preserves immutable anchors and execution state snapshots), and Visual Diff Viewer in ToolExecutionCard. CVH-007-TACTILE.title: Complete full tactile UX and backend architecture for CanbanVoimaxHarness
CVH-007-TACTILE.author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan & tauri-rust-engineer)
CVH-007-TACTILE.commitMessage: feat: complete integration of Card-as-a-Chat, Tool Policy Matrix, Context Compactor, Prefix Caching, and Visual Diff Viewer
CVH-007-TACTILE.summary: Completed full tactile UX and backend architecture for CanbanVoimaxHarness. Frontend integration includes global ToolPolicyModal mounted in App.tsx, Topbar settings button & live token savings badge (⚡ ~2.4k tokens saved/step), unified visual Diff Viewer in ToolExecutionCard with Split/JSON tabs, ContextGauge in AgentConsoleDrawer with fast log evaporation feedback, dynamic execution status badges, and quick prompt suggestions bar ([▶ Продолжай], [🔍 Проверь тесты], [🛑 Откати изменения], [⚡ Сжать контекст]). Rust backend architecture includes State-Preserving Context Compactor (evaporate_tool_logs, 4 Immutable Anchors, generate_state_snapshot), Tool Policy Matrix Zero-Trust Iron Barrier (check_stage_tool_permission), Tool Output Spilling (spill_output_if_large to .cvh/spill/), built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, and Deterministic Prefix Caching in llm/client.rs with Anthropic ephemeral cache control. Resolved all review caveats (JSX tag balance, HeaderName type bounds, closure borrow moves).
